notes: Implemented paths are grounded in repository source and configuration.
Future execution and refresh behavior remains explicitly unknown or held.

components.name: Worker entry/router
components.responsibility: Routes status, auth, Ledger API, and static asset requests.

components.name: GitHub read-only observation
components.responsibility: Reads repository, branch, pull request, checks/status, and reviews through GET requests; failures become fail-closed evidence.

components.name: HumanAction resolution
components.responsibility: Maps ObservedFacts to UNKNOWN, WAIT, NO_ACTION, or ACTION_REQUIRED without treating incomplete evidence as actionable.

components.name: Recordable decision fingerprint
components.responsibility: Builds canonical CONFIRMED + ACTION_REQUIRED decision facts and computes the authoritative server-side SHA-256 fingerprint.

components.name: Cloudflare Access authentication
components.responsibility: Verifies Access JWT issuer, audience, RS256 signature, validity, subject, and Human principal status.

components.name: Ledger authorization guard
components.responsibility: Applies fail-closed authenticate-then-authorize checks for ledger.record and ledger.read.

components.name: Approval Ledger API
components.responsibility: Handles authenticated GET/POST, re-observes before writes, checks idempotency and freshness, and appends recordable decisions.

components.name: D1 Ledger store
components.responsibility: Provides append-only record and recent-history operations with database-enforced invariants.

components.name: Approval intent UI
components.responsibility: Shows decision context and submits APPROVE, REJECT, or DEFER only when the UI gate allows it.

components.name: Ledger history UI
components.responsibility: Reads and renders recent immutable records, empty state, auth failures, and NOT EXECUTED status.

components.name: Cloudflare staging configuration
components.responsibility: Wires the isolated staging Worker to Access policy mode and staging-only LEDGER_DB.

components.name: HANDOFF live GitHub reconciliation
components.responsibility: Reads this repository's default-branch tip, open PRs, checks/status, reviews, and Human-Decision markers through GET-only requests; failures become fail-closed live evidence.

components.name: HANDOFF-V1 evaluator
components.responsibility: Compares architecture.json to current main, classifies snapshot staleness, preserves confirmed/assumed/unknown facts, and resolves nextAction as NO_ACTION, ACTION_REQUIRED, or UNKNOWN without inventing work.

components.name: HANDOFF report generation
components.responsibility: Emits machine-readable handoff.json and Human-readable handoff.md from an evaluated HandoffReport; decision-support only, no Ledger write or execution.

dependencies.name: route status
dependencies.responsibility: Worker invokes observation for status and record validation.

dependencies.name: GitHub REST GET
dependencies.responsibility: Observer reads the configured external repository.

dependencies.name: recordability
dependencies.responsibility: HumanAction and evidence determine whether canonical facts exist.

dependencies.name: GET/POST /api/ledger/records
dependencies.responsibility: Worker routes Ledger requests to the API.

dependencies.name: capability check
dependencies.responsibility: Ledger API requires read or record capability before store access.

dependencies.name: verified Human principal
dependencies.responsibility: Guard authenticates via Access before authorization.

dependencies.name: JWT/JWKS
dependencies.responsibility: Authentication trusts configured Access issuer and audience.

dependencies.name: fresh fingerprint
dependencies.responsibility: POST recomputes and compares the current server fingerprint.

dependencies.name: append/list
dependencies.responsibility: Ledger API accesses the store only after its gates.

dependencies.name: D1 SQL
dependencies.responsibility: Store persists immutable records in Cloudflare D1.

dependencies.name: GET records
dependencies.responsibility: History UI fetches recent records through the Worker.

dependencies.name: staging bindings
dependencies.responsibility: Staging config supplies Access and D1 bindings to runtime gates.

dependencies.name: control-center GitHub GET
dependencies.responsibility: HANDOFF live observer reads this repository through GET-only GitHub REST calls.

dependencies.name: live state
dependencies.responsibility: HANDOFF evaluator consumes fail-closed live observation when classifying nextAction and live differences.

dependencies.name: HandoffReport
dependencies.responsibility: Evaluated handoff facts are formatted into machine- and Human-readable reports.

flows.name: Observe and resolve
flows.responsibility: Read-only GitHub observation becomes a HumanAction and optional recordable fingerprint.

flows.name: Human-gated Ledger record
flows.responsibility: A recordable decision passes Human authentication and authorization before append-only persistence and history display.

flows.name: HANDOFF-V1 context reconciliation
flows.responsibility: Architecture Snapshot facts plus current main and read-only GitHub live state produce a fail-closed handoff report without regenerating the Snapshot or authorizing execution.

externalSystems.name: GitHub
externalSystems.responsibility: Observed read-only for repository and pull-request evidence.

externalSystems.name: Cloudflare Access
externalSystems.responsibility: Authenticates interactive Human principals for the staging Worker.

externalSystems.name: Cloudflare D1
externalSystems.responsibility: Hosts the isolated staging Approval Ledger database.

humanGates.name: Explicit Human decision
humanGates.responsibility: A write requires CONFIRMED evidence, ACTION_REQUIRED, an explicit intent, and an authenticated/authorized Human.

humanGates.name: PR lifecycle decisions
humanGates.responsibility: Ready and merge decisions remain Human actions; the Control Center observes but does not execute them.

holds.name: No recordable decision
holds.responsibility: Ledger POST returns NO_RECORDABLE_DECISION unless evidence is CONFIRMED and HumanAction is ACTION_REQUIRED.

holds.name: Execution disabled
holds.responsibility: Ledger records declare externalEffect=false and the UI labels them NOT EXECUTED.

decisions.name: Fail closed on incomplete evidence or auth
decisions.responsibility: Unknown observation, invalid Access identity, and absent authorization policy deny progress.

decisions.name: Ledger is append-only
decisions.responsibility: Application exposes no update/delete path and D1 triggers reject both operations.

decisions.name: HANDOFF is decision-support only
decisions.responsibility: HANDOFF-V1 reconstructs current state and nextAction without regenerating the Snapshot, writing the Ledger, mutating GitHub/Cloudflare, or authorizing execution.

unknowns.name: Action Gateway contract
unknowns.responsibility: No Action Gateway implementation or approved contract exists in this snapshot.

unknowns.name: Agent execution path
unknowns.responsibility: No path from Ledger records to Agent execution is implemented.

unknowns.name: Automatic snapshot refresh
unknowns.responsibility: Watcher, scheduled regeneration, and staleness automation are not defined in V1.

assumptions.name: Observation target remains configured in code
assumptions.responsibility: The snapshot assumes the current hard-coded severe-behavior-support-spfx observation target remains intentional until a later decision changes it.

staleIndicators.name: Worker sources changed
staleIndicators.responsibility: Treat changes under src/worker/** as architecture-relevant.

staleIndicators.name: Architecture configuration changed
staleIndicators.responsibility: Treat wrangler.jsonc, migrations/**, package.json, and architecture generator changes as relevant.

staleIndicators.name: HANDOFF-V1 sources changed
staleIndicators.responsibility: Treat changes to scripts/run-handoff.ts and HANDOFF domain modules as architecture-relevant.

staleIndicators.name: Schema or generator changed
staleIndicators.responsibility: Regenerate when schemaVersion differs from 1.0 or generator differs from ARCH-SNAPSHOT-GEN-V1.
